characters.name: Thom

characters.name: Celia
characters.label: the young woman
characters.look: A young woman with light brown hair pulled back, wearing a blue and black vest and sporting a mechanical robotic right arm.

characters.name: Thom
characters.label: the older gray-haired man
characters.look: An older man with gray hair, a full gray beard, and a worn plaid coat over dark clothing.

characters.label: the cyborg commander
characters.look: A burly man wearing an elaborate multi-lens eyepiece over his right eye and an ornate red patchwork coat.

characters.name: Barley
characters.label: the sniper
characters.look: A Black soldier wearing dark padded combat gear and aiming a futuristic sniper rifle.

characters.label: the female soldier

scenes.summary: On a canal bridge in Amsterdam, Celia argues with Thom over their future and accuses him of being uncomfortable with her robotic arm. Thom admits his fear, ending their relationship.

facts.text: Celia calls Thom a jerk during an argument on a canal bridge.
Thom says they must follow their separate passions, contrasting her robotics work with his desire to go to space.
Celia claims Thom is freaked out by her mechanical robotic arm.
Thom admits he has nightmares about being pursued by giant robotic claws.

scenes.summary: Forty years after the breakup, the past conversation is revealed to be a wireframe holographic simulation. Technicians in a high-tech lab synchronize the memory to a biological brain.

facts.text: A title card indicates the scene is set forty years later.
The console operator announces that the robot's memory is synchronized and locked.
A biological human brain connected to electrodes sits on a small dish.
The cyborg commander examines the wired brain and calls it freaky.

scenes.summary: High above the ruined city, Barley watches an approaching flying warship through his rifle scope. Beside him, an older gray-haired man wakes up under an old newspaper.

facts.text: The film title 'TEARS OF STEEL' appears.
A newspaper covering the sleeping man reads 'Roboticist Creates Killer Robots'.
A massive armored airship floats over the skyline of Amsterdam.
The older gray-haired man mentions hearing the team talking about him the previous night.
Barley drinks from a carton of mango juice while maintaining watch.

scenes.summary: The older gray-haired man rappels down from the cathedral bell tower on a rope. He crosses the dilapidated church floor toward a brightly lit room.

facts.text: The older gray-haired man rappels down a rope suspended in the nave.
He enters an enclosed room outfitted with books, maps, and lamps.

scenes.summary: The cyborg commander readies the older gray-haired man for his role as Barley gives a time estimate. The commander reminds him to speak with tenderness as the simulation begins.

facts.text: The commander addresses the sniper as Barley over radio, who replies they have about ten minutes.
The commander calls the older man Thom and points out the giant robot outside.
The commander instructs Thom to be tender and remind her what love is.

scenes.summary: A projection of Young Thom appears on the bridge as a massive mechanical walker looms ahead. The commander calls action and initiates the memory overwrite.

facts.text: A holographic avatar of Young Thom materializes on the canal bridge.
A giant bipedal war mech approaches the bridge facing Young Thom.
The commander calls action, and the console operator presses playback to start the memory overwrite.

scenes.summary: The giant robot projects Celia's form, and Young Thom repeats their past argument. When Thom deviates from the script to apologize, Celia's robotic appendage grabs him by the throat.

facts.text: The giant robot projects a holographic overlay of Celia's face.
Barley warns over the radio that hostile machines are two minutes away.
Thom goes off script and admits he was young and foolish.
Celia's mechanical hand snaps forward and pins Young Thom by the neck.

scenes.summary: Alarms trigger in the control room as the console operator screams in panic. On the bridge, Celia confronts Thom about abandoning her, and his sincere apology pauses her attack.

facts.text: The commander orders an abort as the console flashes critical error warnings.
Celia screams at Thom that he broke her heart and left her on Earth.
Thom says he is sorry, softening Celia's grip on his avatar.
The holographic projection dissipates, revealing Celia's mechanical walker standing alone.

scenes.summary: Enemy machines assault the building, forcing Barley to slide down a cable and join the defense. Inside, the defenders exchange heavy fire with invading spider robots.

facts.text: Barley fires at robots scaling the tower before ziplining down into the cathedral.
Defenders strap on modular forearm weapons to defend the interior.
Multiple spider mechs break into the greenhouse and exchange fire with the resistance.
The console operator announces that the memory overwrite has reached ninety percent.
The female soldier urges the commander to abort, addressing him as Captain.

scenes.summary: Young Thom delivers a final heartfelt plea before Old Thom steps onto the bridge in person. As the overwrite finishes, Thom touches Celia's machine, and the robot army shuts down.

facts.text: Young Thom tells Celia that the world has changed and they can too.
Old Thom steps out onto the bridge directly in front of the colossal robot.
The console operator confirms that the memory overwrite is complete.
Old Thom places his hands tenderly onto the chassis of the giant robot.
The attacking war machines across the city collapse and deactivate.

scenes.summary: End credits roll over stylized orange and blue technical graphics depicting cybernetic joints, circuitry, and machine schematics.

facts.text: The stylized graphic credits sequence begins.

scenes.summary: In the aftermath, Barley relaxes atop a towering mountain of destroyed robot parts. He takes a drink from his juice box and sighs contentedly.

facts.text: Barley is seated high atop a massive pile of deactivated robot bodies.
Barley drinks the remainder of his mango juice.

subtitles.text: Look Celia, we have to follow our passions;
...you have your robotics, and I just want to be awesome in space.
Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand?
I'm not freaked out by- it's...
I'm freaked out! I have nightmares that I'm being chased...
...by these giant robotic claws of death...
"Fourty years later" Whatever, Thom. We're done.
I heard you guys talking last night.
It's not my fault, you know.
Of course you're ready, you're a rockstar.
We should have about ten minutes...
We're on in one! All systems go! Yeah you, go!
Go! Move your asses! Go go go!
I love it! Come on, go!
We have to follow our passions.
...and I just want to be awesome in space.
Okay, they're coming. Two minutes left!
Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand?
But that's no reason to destroy the world.
There's a lesson to be learned from this.

gemini_logline: Forty years after a bitter romantic breakup triggers a catastrophic future ruled by killer robots, a ragtag human resistance prepares a memory simulation to rewrite history.
logline: In a future Amsterdam overrun by machines, a small band of scientists and soldiers bets everything on replaying one moment from the past.

ad.text: Text on black background: "Blender Foundation Presents", then "the Mango Open Movie project". Rocket thrusters ignite with intense white flame inside a launch structure.
A rocket ascends over a futuristic cityscape. Text: "This film is supported by the Netherlands Film Fund".
Glowing wireframe figures mimic Thom and Celia on screen.
A preserved human brain rests on a dish, surrounded by a glowing energy ring.
Title: "TEARS OF STEEL". A foggy city with traditional houses beneath massive industrial structures and airborne vessels.
Inside a bell tower, a man lies under a newspaper headline: "ROBOTICIST CREATES KILLER ROBOTS". Nearby, a sniper takes aim.
Through a telescopic sight, a dark flying ship hovers above rooftops. The sniper lowers his rifle slightly and glances up.
The ship fires glowing projectiles before crashing through roofs. In the tower, the gray-haired man wakes as the newspaper blows away.
Through the scope, the damaged vessel plows through brick houses, leaving a trail of destruction.
The gray-haired man sits up, groaning and rubbing his shoulder, while the sniper keeps watch through his scope.
The sniper glances back at him. The gray-haired man grabs a thick rope to pull himself up. The sniper sips from a juice carton.
The gray-haired man slides down a long rope suspended in a grand, ruined church hall, landing on his feet.
He holds his shoulder and walks toward a glowing yellow portal at the far end.
He enters a dimly lit room where a female soldier in camouflage stands waiting. He walks past her toward a broken brick wall.
He steps out onto a balcony, where a giant robot stands on a bridge.
The commander spreads his arms as a glowing dome expands around.
The commander puts his arms around.
The commander guides Thom forward as a green holographic interface scans them and projects the simulation onto the bridge.
Young Thom materializes on the bridge as a translucent hologram. He looks at his hands, then walks forward along the canal bridge.
Young Thom walks beside the canal, his leather jacket featuring a colorful lion illustration on the back.
Thom stops opposite the giant robot, which lowers its mechanical head toward him. In the control room, the commander speaks into a mic.
The robot head morphs into young Celia. Floating pink text appears in the air behind Thom as he speaks to her.
A golden sunset illuminates city towers. Through a scope, a robot climbs across rooftops in the distance.
Pink text floats beside them: "CELIA, I LOVE YOUR ROBOT HAND".
An error message flashes red on screen.
The console operator stares in disbelief. On the bridge, the robotic claw gently cradles Thom's face.
Celia stares at Thom. A holographic wave ripples across her, returning her to robot form.
A massive shadow looms over the cathedral interior.
Barley opens fire on a robot attacking the tower balcony. The robot smashes the balustrade, sending Barley tumbling back.
A scientist loads a glowing power cell into a heavy gauntlet and hands it to a young colleague, who attaches it to his arm.
The young man aims the gauntlet device forward, his face tense with concentration.
In a sunlit hall, technicians in white suits fire energy beams from gauntlets at invading giant robots smashing through the structure.
Barley slides down a rope, activates a device on his harness, and swings through the cathedral rafters.
A robot smashes into the cathedral organ loft.
Organ pipes collapse in a huge explosion as Barley swings on a rope, firing wildly.
On the bridge, the giant robot lowers its head close to young Thom as he speaks to it gently.
A robot smashes through machinery in the hall. Outside, a giant mothership hovers. In the church, old Thom stands beside the passive robot head.
The console operator works at his terminal. Old Thom gently rests his hands against the side of the robot's head.
Thom gazes emotionally at the robot's mechanical face.
A robot crashes into the room. Outside, old Thom stands alone in a circular courtyard surrounded by several giant robots.
The camera pulls back high above the courtyard where Thom stands surrounded by the still, towering robots.
